name: Crystal Force
label: Quest
description: Crystal Force: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Pylon table allows you to combine green power crystals with blue power crystals.
According to J.D.'s manual, this combination can be used to increase your spirit.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Arranging the crystals on the table, you carefully align the colors. As you push the last one into place, a burst of light fuses the crystals together.
The resulting combination is now yours.
